metadata.description: Monoceros plugins: structured product discovery in your team's tools, plus a quick on-ramp from a raw idea to a running Monoceros workbench.

plugins.name: discovery-atlassian
plugins.description: From a raw idea to a complete product plan: product brief, personas and journeys, design brief, technical brief and a Jira backlog - a guided dialog in your Atlassian tools that ends Monoceros Workbench ready.

plugins.name: quickstart
plugins.description: Turn an idea into a local, running dev container fast: a short guided dialog maps it onto the Monoceros catalog and hands you the exact init/apply/run commands plus a build prompt for the AI agent. The quick on-ramp to the workbench.
